{{Quote|We, the members of the Jedi Council, have created this record of those terrible events.|The Council member|audio=UnidentifiedJediNarrator.flac|<ref name="B&R" />}}
An unidentified '''Jedi Master''' who was part of a [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] narrated the events surrounding the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Naboo Crisis]]. After the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] sent [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to settle the conflict, the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] decided to create a [[Naboo Crisis record|record]] of the ongoing events. The Jedi recording device captured images and sounds from the conflict, and the unidentified [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] later added his own narration to tie all the data together. The Jedi Master concluded his story on a worried note, stating that the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], the eternal enemies of the Jedi, were "lurking somewhere in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]... waiting for a chance to strike."<ref name="B&R" /> Around the same timen the council member also lent his voice to the recoded version of the ''[[Junior Jedi Training Manual]]''.<ref name="JJTM">''[[Star Wars Episode I: Junior Jedi Training Manual]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The unidentified Jedi Council member was created as a narrating device for the [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (book-and-record)|book-and-record]] adaptation of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], in which he was voiced by the [[Wikipedia:United States of America|American]] voice-over artist [[Peter Francis James]]. While the adaptation treats the narrator as a real, [[in-universe]] character, he was aware of events that he should not have known&mdash;such as a private conversation between [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] and his apprentice [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]]. The record implies that the narrator was in fact a member of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]].<ref name="B&R" /> In this case, the unidentified Jedi Master must be one of the nine male councilors that sat in the High Council at the time of ''The Phantom Menace''<ref name="TPMV">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> to the exclusion of [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], who were voiced by their own actors in the record.<ref name="B&R" />
